notes: Not an enginehost family: no open Unity player exists to run either scripting backend on Android. Enginehost's enrichment then says why it cannot run the game rather than failing generically: IL2CPP (GameAssembly.dll, <name>_Data/il2cpp_data) or Mono (<name>_Data/Managed), the player's machine architecture from its PE/ELF header, and the Unity version from the head of globalgamemanagers / data.unity3d / mainData.
